Targ. I Sam. XVII, 46 (ed. Lag. פגר).—Esp. piggul, v. preced.

Men. 94ᵃ (a mnemonical formula) שכן ציבורא חובה טמיא דאכיל פ׳ בשבתא for the show-bread is, like the ʿOmer, a congregational offering, an obligatory offering, is offered when the congregation is unclean, is eaten by the priests, is subject to becoming piggul, and is offered on the Sabbath; ib.ᵇ
